what this is: A recorded session from one working week, twenty facts memory learned from it, and twenty questions a later task might ask. Every question must be answered by search with the right fact among the first three results. The events are here so that the index holds real messages competing with the facts, which is what makes the ranking worth testing.

body.text: post about the anniversary today and keep it short
I will draft a post about the anniversary and check the character count
check the mining pool dashboard and tell me the hash rate
draft the newsletter for this month and send me the draft
the blog build failed again, have a look at it
book the conference talk slot for me
send the invoice to the client please
record the podcast intro before the meeting

facts.text: the DigiByte anniversary falls on the tenth of January every year
the blog is served from blog.digibyte.org and is built with Hugo
a post on X has to stay under two hundred and eighty characters
the user works in the America/New_York time zone
the product notes are kept in memory/product.md
the user wants a single idea in each post and nothing more
the release checklist is make check then make live before tagging
the mining pool dashboard is at pool.digihash.co
the laptop runs Ubuntu twenty four point zero four
the wallet repository is digibytewallet-core and its default branch is develop
the newsletter goes out on the first Monday of the month
the logo artwork is in the brand folder as scalable vector files
the support address people write to is help@digibyte.org
the conference talk is twenty minutes with five more for questions
the user drinks coffee only before noon
the staging server is reached over ssh as coeus at 10.0.0.7
the podcast is recorded on Thursdays at four in the afternoon
a design review needs two approvals before anything is merged
the dog is called Rocket and hates the vacuum cleaner
the invoice template lives in accounts/invoice.odt
